# PaySQL

> PaySQL is an open-source, modular, REST-ready payroll and salary-management platform built on
> Oracle PL/SQL. It manages employees, component-based compensation, leave, tax/statutory
> deductions, and full pay-run cycles, with the database as the source of truth and a REST API
> via Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS). Think "Bagisto/Magento for payroll," PL/SQL-native.

PaySQL began as a university PL/SQL project and is being modernized into a production-grade
open-source product following a phased roadmap. Keywords: open source payroll, Oracle PL/SQL
salary management, ORDS payroll API, HR payroll database, open source HRIS.
